# LoglineLab
> Free logline checker for indie filmmakers. Paste a film logline to get scores (hook, stakes, protagonist, genre clarity, marketability) and suggested rewrites. Runs in-browser, no signup.

## Tool
- [Logline checker](https://tcprod1.github.io/loglinelab/): instant scoring and rewrites

## Guides
- [What makes a great logline](https://tcprod1.github.io/loglinelab/what-makes-a-great-logline.html)
- [Logline examples by genre](https://tcprod1.github.io/loglinelab/logline-examples-by-genre.html)
- [Logline formula](https://tcprod1.github.io/loglinelab/logline-formula.html)
